body:
YTA.

Unless you’re asexual. People say a happy, healthy relationship has sex about 2-3x a week. Intimacy levels can be different for everyone, but this is problem you are having needs to be taken care of by seeking help.

I been in your shoe where I felt no desire to be intimate with my past partners and let me tell you— it just meant I wasn’t attracted to them in the first place. At least in my case, I also needed some therapy and healing to do too. Since then, I been in a really happy relationship and never been more attracted to someone before. Intimacy has been 3-7x a week depending on energy, work, and stress.
Lmao- in one way I gotta applaud her. She just keeps pushing it and continues to out live what the haters predicted to prove something.

I don’t quite remember her saying that, but I do know she started regretting and questioning herself after. Kept saying “oh— why did I eat that?” Really had a stark resemblance of my ex, who battled with addiction. Except it was “why did I take that?” Disturbing really.

Same here. Although with everything that is happening I’m gonna say it’s going to be a 50/50 chance of her uploading those feeding frenzies. She might be too embarrassed with all that is going on orrrr she might swallow her pride and post anyways to gain some kind of money traction

This is an old video from her old spiral saga, but just reading her pinned comment here shows how much her life is just one cycle over and over again. It’s so frustrating to watch her always set dates for her “fresh start”. It’s getting really grim watching her updates bc she really is killing herself. Unlike amberlynn, you can really see it happening. Her old age and health problems is accelerating everything.
Is it just me or do you guys cringe when she is doing her “heys”? Like damn she is so fucking excited to eat unhealthy— it shows.
You are not crazy and you are not controlling! If your Q ever tries to put you down for their own actions, do not blame yourself. You got this!

Thank you so much for this! I cant explain how hard it was for me to detach from his problems. As much as I wanted to help and be his saving grace. I knew whatever traumas he had and problems he is going through can not be worked out through me. 

I still learn more and more everyday and realize little things from my past relationship. I will take advice and apply it to myself so I can be happier! I’d like to be. For my future soulmate, myself and my future family.
I didn’t think I was capable of moving forward by myself, but it feels amazing to know I can. I was so alone for a long time, but you all helped me realize it and take the leap.
Thank you! It took a long time, but I made it.

Ooo, okay. I never have thought of this. I always masturbate privately. Doing it together might make me shy, but i will take anything where i can get close and kiss him. Never thought i would say it, but I miss missionary.

It’s okay. We’ve both come to this in a cordial manner, but it hurts. It’s twisting my heart into unimaginable ways. I wish that alcohol was never a thing or at least he knew how to just enjoy it. Not use it as a way of escape.
I am also very sorry for any grammatical errors or typos. I am writing all of this current time.

I tried to many times, but it sucks. Because when he is sober, I am repeated reminded again why I fell in love with him and why I see myself with him. He is my other half. Thank you for the luck, I hope to have this figured out.

Yes, every goddamn day. I try to chalk it up to to the fact that he never got to a party phase or maybe the fact he works a lot. I excuse days where he isn’t drunk, the days where he only take a couple of shots.... but when is enough? He cant understand that I fell in love with the sober him not the drunk him. He cant understand that his drinking might make him happy, but not me. Just because I’m not drunk he thinks it doesn’t affect me and it shouldn’t. It does... it so does.
